sentences.text: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci -LRB- -LSB- leoˈnardo di ˌsɛr ˈpjɛːro da -LRB- v -RRB- ˈvintʃi -RSB- ; 15 April 14522 May 1519 -RRB- , more commonly Leonardo da Vinci or simply Leonardo , was an Italian polymath whose areas of interest included invention , painting , sculpting , architecture , science , music , mathematics , engineering , literature , anatomy , geology , astronomy , botany , writing , history , and cartography .	Vinci	Vinci, Italy	Italian	Italians	polymath	polymath	invention	invention	painting	painting	sculpting	sculpting	architecture	architecture	science	science	music	music	mathematics	mathematics	engineering	engineering	literature	literature	anatomy	anatomy	geology	geology	astronomy	astronomy	botany	botany	writing	writing	history	history	cartography	cartography

He has been variously called the father of palaeontology , ichnology , and architecture , and is widely considered one of the greatest painters of all time .	architecture	architecture	palaeontology	paleontology	ichnology	ichnology

Sometimes credited with the inventions of the parachute , helicopter and tank , he epitomised the Renaissance humanist ideal .	parachute	parachute	helicopter	helicopter	tank	tank	Renaissance humanist	Renaissance humanism

Many historians and scholars regard Leonardo as the prime exemplar of the `` Universal Genius '' or `` Renaissance Man '' , an individual of `` unquenchable curiosity '' and `` feverishly inventive imagination '' .	Universal Genius	Universal Genius

According to art historian Helen Gardner , the scope and depth of his interests were without precedent in recorded history , and `` his mind and personality seem to us superhuman , while the man himself mysterious and remote '' .	history	history	Helen Gardner	Helen Gardner (art historian)

Marco Rosci notes that while there is much speculation regarding his life and personality , his view of the world was logical rather than mysterious , and that the empirical methods he employed were unorthodox for his time .

Born out of wedlock to a notary , Piero da Vinci , and a peasant woman , Caterina , in Vinci in the region of Florence , Leonardo was educated in the studio of the renowned Florentine painter Andrea del Verrocchio .	Vinci	Vinci, Italy	out of wedlock	Legitimacy (law)	notary	notary	Florence	Florence	Andrea del Verrocchio	Andrea del Verrocchio
Much of his earlier working life was spent in the service of Ludovico il Moro in Milan .	Ludovico il Moro	Ludovico il Moro

He later worked in Rome , Bologna and Venice , and he spent his last years in France at the home awarded to him by Francis I of France .	Bologna	Bologna	Venice	Venice	Francis I of France	Francis I of France
Leonardo was , and is , renowned primarily as a painter .

Among his works , the Mona Lisa is the most famous and most parodied portrait and The Last Supper the most reproduced religious painting of all time .	Mona Lisa	Mona Lisa	The Last Supper	The Last Supper (Leonardo da Vinci)	painting	painting

Leonardo 's drawing of the Vitruvian Man is also regarded as a cultural icon , being reproduced on items as varied as the euro coin , textbooks , and T-shirts .	Vitruvian Man	Vitruvian Man	cultural icon	cultural icon
Perhaps fifteen of his paintings have survived.There are 15 significant artworks which are ascribed , either in whole or in large part , to Leonardo by most art historians .
This number is made up principally of paintings on panel but includes a mural , a large drawing on paper and two works which are in the early stages of preparation .
There are a number of other works that have also been variously attributed to Leonardo .

Nevertheless , these few works , together with his notebooks , which contain drawings , scientific diagrams , and his thoughts on the nature of painting , compose a contribution to later generations of artists rivalled only by that of his contemporary , Michelangelo .	painting	painting	Michelangelo	Michelangelo
Leonardo is revered for his technological ingenuity .	his technological ingenuity	Science and inventions of Leonardo da Vinci

He conceptualised flying machines , a type of armoured fighting vehicle , concentrated solar power , an adding machine , and the double hull .	armoured fighting vehicle	armoured fighting vehicle	concentrated solar power	concentrated solar power	adding machine	adding machine	double hull	double hull

Relatively few of his designs were constructed or even feasible during his lifetime , as the modern scientific approaches to metallurgy and engineering were only in their infancy during the Renaissance .	engineering	engineering	metallurgy	metallurgy

Some of his smaller inventions , however , such as an automated bobbin winder and a machine for testing the tensile strength of wire , entered the world of manufacturing unheralded .	bobbin	bobbin	tensile strength	tensile strength
A number of Leonardo 's most practical inventions are nowadays displayed as working models at the Museum of Vinci .	Vinci	Vinci, Italy

He made substantial discoveries in anatomy , civil engineering , geology , optics , and hydrodynamics , but he did not publish his findings and they had no direct influence on later science .	science	science	engineering	engineering	anatomy	anatomy	geology	geology	optics	optics	hydrodynamics	fluid dynamics
Today , Leonardo is widely considered one of the most diversely talented individuals ever to have lived .
